objective: Extend the planned thermal-loss evidence checklist so candidate coatings and interfaces report environmental exposure basis, degraded values, uncertainty, and transfer limits before satisfying the loss boundary.
success_metric: Each candidate distinguishes measured fact from extrapolation and evaluates whether effective emissivity <= 0.10 and parasitic conductance <= 5e-5 W/K remain credible after vacuum, radiation, contamination, and thermal-cycling margins.
